services.value: The Sprague River Water Quality Lab (SRWQL) analyzes water nutrients, water chemistry, and algal toxin samples in-house, using automated discrete analyzer technology (Thermo Fisher Aquakem 250) and E-friendly methods. The broader program also provides water quality monitoring by sampling water nutrients, water chemistry, algal toxins, and aquatic biota, and testing parameters such as phosphorus, ammonia, nitrate/nitrite, silicon dioxide, chlorophyll-a, and microcystin toxin.
